cards.card_text: The men of Gilead strike Ephraim down, because of something the Ephraimites had said about them.
cards.verse_text: And the men of Gilead struck them down because the Ephraimites had said, “You Gileadites are fugitives in Ephraim, living in the territories of Ephraim and Manasseh.”

cards.card_text: At the fords, why does saying "Sibboleth" give a man away as an Ephraimite?
cards.verse_text: So at that time 42,000 Ephraimites were killed.

cards.card_text: At that time, 42,000 Ephraimites are killed, and friend, that one sits heavy.

cards.card_text: Jeroboam son of Nebat, an Ephraimite from Zeredah, whose mother is a widow named Zeruah.
cards.verse_text: Now Jeroboam son of Nebat was an Ephraimite from Zeredah whose mother was a widow named Zeruah.
cards.snippet: Now Jeroboam son of Nebat was an Ephraimite from Zeredah whose mother was a widow named Zeruah.

cards.card_text: Then four leaders of the Ephraimites stand up against the soldiers coming home from the war.
cards.verse_text: Then some of the leaders of the Ephraimites—Azariah son of Jehohanan, Berechiah son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah son of Shallum, and Amasa son of Hadlai—stood in opposition to those arriving from the war.
